basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas. I love exploring the intersection of technology and lifestyle, which is why I spend a lot of time on subreddits focused on tech and personal anecdotes. When I'm not coding or browsing Reddit, you can find me trying out new recipes or hiking in the Hill Country. I'm single and usually online during late evenings after work, around 8 PM to midnight. I enjoy engaging in thoughtful discussions and occasionally sharing some of my more adventurous stories.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from UT Austin. My expertise is mainly in software development, particularly in app development and UI/UX design. I've also spent a lot of time self-teaching through online courses and forums to stay updated with the latest tech trends.
